changes.risk: Incorrect scope could overstate approval; fixed toolbar and long labels need actual viewport inspection.
changes.control: v5 exact-scope keys, six preview states, explicit provenance, canonical accessible tokens, linear scoped coverage and frozen feedback target.

changes.risk: Unbounded rows, empty pages after filtering, incorrect global sorting.
changes.control: 25 rows by default, 100 maximum, full-result sorting before slicing, search resets page, clamp after source shrink. This is client pagination, not server pagination.

changes.risk: Current/Goal leakage, draft overwrite, stale preview, implying a completed mesh or fit.
changes.control: Independent semantic contexts, explicit local snapshot, cancel obsolete outline timer, isolated lazy screen, disabled GLB export.

changes.risk: Product leakage, filtered-out selection, duplicate tab identifiers and narrow detail columns.
changes.control: Product/status/plan filtering, selection reset, unique tab IDs, focus restoration and stacked detail below 1296px; no real admin writes.

changes.risk: Duplicate completion, title-key collisions, state loss between views and invented audit streams.
changes.control: Stable task/session IDs, deadline completion deduplication, shell-owned state, distinct read-only sample schemas and current-draft search.

changes.risk: Generic repeated charts could be mistaken for implemented analysis or completed calculators.
changes.control: Named input/output artifact contracts, explicit setup/preview scope, skill-specific records and labelled local dashboard ordering.

diagramAssessment.observed: Versioned semantic documents and an existing per-person serialized save boundary. Demo state stays independent of these production stores.
The inspected identity module evaluates on the CPU through synchronous setWeights. The worker box in the supplied diagram is a target, not an established worker in this module.
Existing single-flight, newest-revision queue and worker. Stale results cannot apply; failure and disposal reject waiting exports.
Production semantic documents and geometry packages have distinct contracts. The review demo exports only clearly labelled sample JSON and does not instantiate the renderer.
